segments.name: Wholesale
segments.description: Distributes branded footwear and apparel through sporting goods stores, outdoor retailers, mass merchants, uniform stores and other wholesale channels worldwide.
segments.evidence: We distribute Muck, XTRATUF, Rocky, Durango, Georgia Boot, Lehigh, Ranger, and Michelin products through a wide range of Wholesale distribution channels throughout the world.

segments.name: Retail
segments.description: Sells branded footwear and apparel directly to consumers through business-to-business web platforms, e-commerce sites, marketplaces and a gear store.
segments.evidence: We market products directly to consumers through three retail strategies: ● Lehigh business-to-business including direct sales and through our CustomFit websites; ● Consumer e-commerce websites (B2C) and third-party marketplaces; and ● Our Rocky Outdoor Gear Store.

segments.name: Contract Manufacturing
segments.description: Bids on footwear contracts with the U.S. Military and private label customers, with sales dependent on winning those bids.
segments.evidence: In addition to contracts with the U.S. Military, we bid on private label contracts.

revenueModel.text: Retailers, distributors, employers and consumers pay the company for branded footwear and apparel, while the U.S. Military and private label customers pay for contract-manufactured footwear.
revenueModel.evidence: Our Contract Manufacturing segment includes sales to the U.S. Military, private label sales and any sales to customers in which we are contracted to manufacture or source a specific footwear product for a customer.
